status: FROZEN battery instantiation (post V1.1 pre-data amendment)
selection_rule: sort eligible unique ytids by sha256(SELECTION_SALT|YTID|ytid) ascending, first 96
caption_rule: Convention B: n=5 caption ROWS (multiset, dups preserved, no dedup) sorted UTF-8; index=int.from_bytes(sha256(SELECTION_SALT|CAPTION|ytid)[:8],'big')%n; caption text NOT hashed

csv_json_discrepancy.explanation: label JSON is the audited canonical eval universe (one row per test caption actually scored); test.csv is the raw AudioCaps release (more caption rows). V1 eligible universe = label-JSON unique ytids.
